sn55.7:1.2: ekam samayam Bhagavā Kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhim yena Veḷudvāraṃ nāma Kosalānam brāhmaṇagāmo tad avasari || || 2.
sn55.7:1.4: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito Kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ Veḷudvāram anuppatto || ||
sn55.7:1.5: Taṃ kho pana Bhagavantam Gotamam evaṃ kalyāṇakittisaddo abbhuggato ||
sn55.7:1.6: Iti pi so Bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānam buddho bhagavā ti ||
sn55.7:1.7: so imaṃ lokam sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakam sassamaṇabrāhmaṇim pajam sadevamanussaṃ sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti ||
sn55.7:1.8: so dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇam majjhe kalyāṇam pariyosāṇakalyānam sāttham savyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇam parisuddham brahmacariyam pakāseti || ||
sn55.7:1.9: Sādhu kho pana tathārūpānam arahataṃ dassanaṃ hoti || || 3.
sn55.7:2.1: Atha kho te Veḷudvāreyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā appekacce Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdiṃsu || appekacce Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu || sammodaniyaṃ katham sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdiṃsu || appekacce yena Bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdiṃsu || appekacce Bhagavato santike nāmagottaṃ sāvetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdiṃsu || appekacce tunhībhūtā ekam antaṃ nisīdiṃsu || || 4. Ekam antaṃ nisinnā kho te Veḷudvareyyākā brāhmaṇagahapatikā Bhagavantam etad avocuṃ || ||
sn55.7:2.2: Mayam bho Gotama evaṃkāmā evaṃchandā evamadhippāyā ||
sn55.7:2.3: puttasambādhasayanam ajjhāvaseyyāma || kāsikacandanam paccanubhaveyyāma || mālāgandhavilepanam dhāreyyāma || jātarūparajataṃ sādiyeyyāma || kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokam upapajjeyyāma || ||
sn55.7:2.4: Tesaṃ no bhavaṃ Gotamo amhākam evaṃkāmānam evaṃchandānam evamadhippāyānaṃ tathā dhammaṃ desetu yathā mayaṃ puttasambādhasayanam ajjhāvaseyyāma || la || sugatiṃ saggam lokam upapajjeyyāmā ti || || 5.
sn55.7:3.2: tam suṇātha || sādhukam manasi karotha bhāsissāmī ti || ||
sn55.7:3.3: Evam bho ti kho te Veḷudvāreyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā Bhagavato paccassosuṃ || ||
sn55.7:4.3: Ahaṃ kho smi jīvitukāmo amaritukāmo sukhakāmo dukkhapaṭikkūlo ||
sn55.7:4.4: yo kho maṃ jīvitukāmam amaritukāmaṃ sukhakāmaṃ dukkhapaṭikkūlam jīvitā voropeyya na me tam assa piyam manāpaṃ || ||
sn55.7:4.5: Ahañceva kho pana paraṃ jīvitukāmam amaritukāmam sukhakāmam dukkhapaṭikūlaṃ jīvitā voropeyyam || parassa tam assa appiyam amanāpaṃ || ||
sn55.7:4.6: Yo kho myāyaṃ dhammo appiyo amanāpo parassa peso dhammo appiyo amanāpo ||
sn55.7:4.7: yo kho myāyam dhammo appiyo amanāpo kathāhaṃ paraṃ tena saṃyojeyyan ti || ||
sn55.7:4.8: So iti paṭisaṅkhāya attanā ca pānātipātā paṭivirato hoti || paraṃ ca pāṇātipātā veramaṇiyā samādapeti || pāṇātipātā veramaṇiyā vaṇṇam bhāsati || ||
sn55.7:4.9: Evam assāyaṃ kāyasamācāro ti koṭiparisuddho hoti || || 7.
sn55.7:5.1: Puna ca param gahapatayo ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati || ||
sn55.7:5.2: Yo kho me adinnam theyyasaṅkhātam ādiyeyya || na me tam assa piyam manāpam ||
sn55.7:5.3: ahaṃ ce va kho pana parassa adinnam theyyasaṅkhātam ādiyeyyaṃ || parassa pi tam assa appiyam amanāpaṃ || ||
sn55.7:5.4: Yo kho myāyaṃ dhammo appiyo amanāpo parassa peso dhammo appiyo amanāpo ||
sn55.7:5.5: yo kho myāyaṃ dhammo appiyo amanāpo kathāham paraṃ tena saṃyojeyyanti || ||
sn55.7:5.6: So iti paṭisaṅkhāya attānañca adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti || parañca adinnādānā veramaṇiyā samādapeti || adinnādānā veramaṇiyā ca vaṇṇam bhāsati || ||
sn55.7:5.7: Evam assāyam kāyasamācāro ti koṭiparisuddho hoti || || 8.
sn55.7:6.1: Puna ca param gahapatayo ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati || ||
sn55.7:6.2: Yo kho me dāresu cārittam āpajjeyya || na me tam assa piyam manāpam ||
sn55.7:6.3: ahaṃ ceva kho pana parassa dāresu cārittam āpajjeyyaṃ || parassa pi tam assa appiyam amanāpaṃ ||
sn55.7:6.4: yo kho myāyaṃ dhammo appiyo amanāpo parassa peso dhammo appiyo amanāpo ||
sn55.7:6.6: so iti paṭisaṅkhāya attanā ca kāmesu micchācārā paṭivirato hoti || paraṃ ca kāmesu micchācārā veramaṇiyā samādapeti || kāmesu micchācārā veramaṇiyā ca vaṇṇam bhāsati || ||
sn55.7:6.7: Evam assāyaṃ kāyasamācāro ti koṭiparisuddho ti || || 9.
sn55.7:7.1: Puna ca paraṃ gahapatayo ariyasāvako iti patisaṃcikkhati || ||
sn55.7:7.2: Yo kho me musāvādena attham bhañjeyya na me tam assa piyam manāpaṃ ||
sn55.7:7.3: ahañ ceva kho pana parassa musāvādena attham bhañjeyyam parassa pi tam assa appiyam amanāpaṃ || ||
sn55.7:7.4: Yo kho myāyaṃ dhammo appiyo amanāpo || parassa peso dhammo appiyo amanāpo ||
sn55.7:7.5: yo kho myāyaṃ dhammo appiyo amanāpo || kathāham paraṃ tena saṃyojeyyan ti || ||
sn55.7:7.6: So iti paṭisaṅkhāya attanā ca musāvādā paṭivirato hoti || parañ ca musāvādā veramaṇiyā samādapeti || musāvādā veramaṇiyā vaṇṇam bhāsati || ||
sn55.7:7.7: Evam assāyam vacīsamācāro ti koṭiparisuddho hoti || || 10.
sn55.7:8.1: Puna ca paraṃ gahapatayo ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati || ||
sn55.7:8.2: Yo kho maṃ pisuṇāya vācāya mittehi bhedeyya na me tam assa piyam manāpam ||
sn55.7:8.3: ahañ ceva kho pana paraṃ pisuṇāya vācāya mittehi bhedeyyaṃ parassa pi tam assa appiyam amanāpam || la ||
sn55.7:8.4: Evaṃ assāyaṃ vācīsamācāro ti koṭiparisuddho hoti || || 11.
sn55.7:9.1: Puna ca paraṃ gahapatayo ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati || ||
sn55.7:9.2: Yo kho mam pharusāya vācāya samudācareyya na me tam assa piyam manāpam ||
sn55.7:9.3: ahañ ceva kho pana param pharusāya vācāya samudācareyyam parassa pi tam assa appiyam amanāpaṃ || ||
sn55.7:9.5: Evam assāyaṃ vacīsamācāro ti koṭiparisuddho hoti || || 12.
sn55.7:10.1: Puna ca paraṃ gahapatayo ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati ||
sn55.7:10.2: Yo kho mam sampabhāsena samphappalāpabhāsena samudācareyya na me tam assa piyam manāpaṃ ||
sn55.7:10.3: ahañ ceva kho pana param sampabhāsena samphappalāpabhāsena samudācareyya || parassa pi tam assa appiyam amanāpaṃ || ||
sn55.7:10.4: Yo kho myāyam dhammo appiyo amanāpo parassa peso dhammo appiyo amanāpo ||
sn55.7:10.5: yo myāyam dhammo appiyo amanāpo kathāham paraṃ tena saṃyojeyyanti || ||
sn55.7:10.6: So iti patisaṅkhāya attanāca samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti || paraṃ ca samphappalāpā veramaṇiyā samādapeti || samphappalāpā veramaṇiyā ca vaṇṇam bhāsati || ||
sn55.7:10.7: Evam assāyam vacīsamācāro ti koṭiparisuddho hoti || || 13.
sn55.7:11.2: Iti pi so Bhagavā || la-pe || sattha devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā ti || || 14.
sn55.7:11.4: Saṅghe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti || supaṭipanno Bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho || la-pe || anuttaram puññakkhettam lokassā ti || || 16.
sn55.7:11.5: Ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi || la || samādhisaṃvattanikehi || || 17.
sn55.7:11.6: Yato kho gahapatayo ariyasāvako imehi sattahi saddhammehi samannāgato hoti || imehi catuhi ākaṅkhiyehi ṭhānehi so ākaṅkhamāno attanā vā attānaṃ vyākareyya
sn55.7:11.7: Khīṇanirayo mhi khīṇatiracchānayoniko khīṇapittivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto || sotāpanno ham asmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano ti || || 18.
sn55.7:12.1: Evaṃ vutte Veḷudvāreyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā Bhagavantam etad avocuṃ || ||
sn55.7:12.3: ete mayam bhagavantaṃ Gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāma dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca ||
sn55.7:12.4: Upāsake no bhavaṃ Gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pānupete saraṇaṃ gate
